title: py-msx-emulator machine snapshot, format 19
description: The save-state layout written by msx/state.py save_state(): RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON, integers only (within +-(2^53 - 1)), byte blobs as padded RFC 4648 base64 strings. Every property is required; null means the machine has no such part. Lengths that depend on the machine (RAM, VRAM, SRAM sizes) and cross-field rules are checked by the loader, not here.

machine_config_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical MachineConfig document the machine was built from (msx/machine_config.schema.json); empty only for a machine constructed without one.
